name: china-study-costs
title: Studying in China: Tuition, Living Costs, Year Totals and Scholarships (2026)
description: Studying in China: Tuition, Living Costs, Year Totals and Scholarships (2026): Tuition by track, published living-cost items, an estimated full year and the scholarships and government quotas open to international bachelor students. The Long Bet, original research by M. Atamanova. Snapshot 2026-10-23.

fields.name: cost_id
fields.description: Row id: `<university_id or city>__<item>__<nn>`.

fields.name: university_id
fields.description: Stable slug of the university, the same id as in the other Long Bet datasets (e.g. `tsinghua-university`).

fields.name: city
fields.description: City in English.

fields.name: item
fields.description: Cost item (snake_case), e.g. `dorm_single`, `canteen_meals`, `insurance`, `residence_permit_fee`.

fields.name: period
fields.description: Period the amount refers to, e.g. `per_year`, `per_month`, `one_off`.

fields.name: academic_cycle
fields.description: Year or cycle of the published amount.

fields.name: condition
fields.description: What the amount applies to (room type, campus, who pays).

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code of the local amounts in this row.

fields.name: amount_local
fields.description: Amount in local currency when the source gives one figure. Unit: `currency` per `period`.

fields.name: amount_usd
fields.description: `amount_local` / `fx_rate`, rounded. Unit: USD per `period`.

fields.name: amount_min_local
fields.description: Lower end of a published range. Unit: `currency` per `period`.

fields.name: amount_min_usd
fields.description: `amount_min_local` / `fx_rate`, rounded. Unit: USD per `period`.

fields.name: amount_max_local
fields.description: Upper end of a published range. Unit: `currency` per `period`.

fields.name: amount_max_usd
fields.description: `amount_max_local` / `fx_rate`, rounded. Unit: USD per `period`.

fields.name: fx_rate
fields.description: Units of `currency` per 1 USD used for the *_usd columns (CNY 6.6786, HKD 7.8476, USD 1.0).

fields.name: fx_date
fields.description: Date of the exchange rate, ISO 8601 (2026-10-21).
